title: Two and a half years, two arrests
subtitle: The Cristian Rangel case, as Austin police have laid it out in court records
alt: Timeline of the Cristian Rangel case as described in Austin police court records: Rangel was last seen on April 8, 2024, the day of that year's total solar eclipse; his girlfriend reported him missing on April 9; his body was found in a southeast Austin greenbelt eleven days later; Kamery Wooldridge was arrested in June 2024 and later sentenced for tampering with a corpse; and Xzaria White-Wooldridge was arrested in September 2026 on a felony witness-tampering charge
source: Austin Police Department court records, via KXAN

events.label: Rangel tells his girlfriend he is going to Walmart
events.note: The day of that year’s total solar eclipse

events.label: His girlfriend reports him missing
events.note: He had been missing since the day before, she told police

events.label: His body is found in a southeast Austin greenbelt
events.note: Its condition made forensic testing difficult, police said

events.label: Kamery Wooldridge is arrested
events.note: Later sentenced to 10 years for tampering with a corpse

next.label: No one has been charged with the homicide itself; the investigation remains open
